claims: Rory McIlroy won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2025–2026.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2001–2002.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1989–1990.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1965–1966.
Rory McIlroy, Tiger Woods, Nick Faldo, and Jack Nicklaus are the only four golfers in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Following his 2026 victory, Rory McIlroy became the fourth player to win back-to-back Masters tournaments at Augusta National.
No golfer has ever won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
